notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35818932/12c4f028bd725df951b594d28df1e310d31945b4.png

The game had been developed for 2 and a half years. It is a good time for me to let it goes to the people. I am very excited to meet all of you. 
Thank you to everyone who had been supporting and tested the games for me. 
Without you, I can't have this day.

Hopefully, people will join this game as I did when I made it. 
See you till the next update.

notes.title: New Gameplay Demo Update Version 0.6
notes.notes:
After received feedbacks. I have decided to recreate the whole new gameplay, in order to deliver OP vs OP experienced to players.

Update:
* Upgrade visuals
* Changed gameplay into fast paces.
* Make player free to move + Dash
* Enemies are more aggressive and fast
* Bullet hell
* Added new bosses

Please check it out. And try to win your destiny.

This might take up to 12 hours to upload the game on the store.
